purpose: Detect performance/resource degradation before it becomes a human-observable field defect.

collection.production_mode: cheap rolling counters only; no per-frame JSON/logging/allocation
collection.diagnostic_mode: deeper tracing explicitly enabled only for bounded diagnosis

rules: Metrics must be available without serial console access.
Normal collection must not allocate/log once per rendered frame.
Every performance sample must identify kernel/variant.
Frame-time percentiles are authoritative over average FPS for smoothness regressions.
Heap health includes free heap, minimum free heap, and largest free block; free heap alone is insufficient.
Install health and runtime qualification remain separate gates.
Diagnostic sweep and foundation qualification are distinct modes: missing tail metrics must not force a new build before the current diagnostic firmware has ranked all 28 kernels.
Foundation telemetry must expose the full kernel/palette/audio/scheduler/overlay/AUX/unaccounted stage budget; a successful average FPS alone is insufficient.

Native Matrix→AUX DDP health is measured from AUX /json/info live=true, lm=DDP, and lip=192.168.77.10; this is distinct from optional HBNFAUX frame-lock packets. Preserve HBNFAUX receive counters and age as diagnostics, but do not use that custom-protocol age as a gate for native WLED DDP freshness.

aux_projection_source_contract.matrix_send_age_must_not_be_used: Matrix HBNF timing.auxProjectionAgeMs is sender-side and does not prove AUX receipt.
aux_projection_source_contract.age_gate: Do not enforce a numeric projectionRxAgeMs ceiling unless HBNFAUX frame-lock streaming is an explicit required active path; Foundation native DDP acceptance uses receiver live/source status.

diagnostic_sweep.purpose: Use the already-installed diagnostic firmware to rank all retained kernels without requiring a new firmware solely for tail-metric support.

foundation.purpose: Full performance/resource qualification of the corrected foundation candidate.
